annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1426 of 5 August 2022 laying down rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2019/2144 as regards uniform procedures and technical specifications for the type-approval of the automated driving system (ADS) of fully automated vehicles
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1426 of 5 August 2022 laying down rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2019/2144 as regards uniform procedures and technical specifications for the type-approval of the automated driving system (ADS) of fully automated vehicles
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 221/1
annotation.summary_en: EU implementing regulation setting uniform procedures and technical specifications for type-approval of automated driving systems of fully automated vehicles (hub-to-hub, predefined areas, automated valet parking). It requires performance, safety management system audits, scenario-based testing, cybersecurity and software update compliance, data recording, and in-service reporting.
key_provisions_or_claims: Applies to type-approval of ADS for fully automated M and N category vehicles in defined use cases
Manufacturers must show the ADS is free of unreasonable safety risk compared with manual driving
Requires safety management system certificate, audits and in-service monitoring and reporting
ADS must record event data and comply with UN Regulations 155 and 156 on cybersecurity and software updates
No weighting of human life by personal characteristics in unavoidable-collision scenarios; minimal risk manoeuvre required on failure
